evidence.exact_span: There is ample authority in support of the proposition that Order 7 rule 9 applies to service outside the jurisdiction in addition to service within Australia: Takapana Investments Pty Ltd v Teco Information Systems Co Ltd (1998) 82 FCR 25; Swan Brewery Co Ltd v Atlee [1998] FCA 277 ; Mercator Property Consultants Pty Ltd v Christmas Island Resort Pty Ltd [1998] FCA 896 and Immerman v London Pie Co Pty Ltd [2000] FCA 97 at [17] .
